# DejaVu Serif fixture

Unmodified `DejaVuSerif.ttf` from the installed Debian DejaVu font package (`/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf`), pinned for real serif corner-rounding regression tests. Upstream: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/ . License: [existing DejaVu license](../../public/fonts/LICENSE-DejaVu.txt), which covers the font family and redistribution. This is not the synthetic Japanese fixture.

SHA-256: `8cb29f7db250ebb2551a6ce2c1e0bfd5a0eb520e9e233370db0493e82e1f36f7`.
